def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    sep, bg, mk = cnt.most_common(3)[0][0], None, None
    # separator color: full rows/cols; find bg and marker among others
    rsep = [i for i in range(H) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for j in range(W))]
    csep = [j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(H))]
    rs = [-1] + rsep + [H]; cs = [-1] + csep + [W]
    inner = Counter()
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            for r in grid[rs[i]+1:rs[i+1]]:
                for x in r[cs[j]+1:cs[j+1]]:
                    inner[x] += 1
    bg = inner.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mk = [c for c in inner if c != bg][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            b = [grid[x][y] for x in range(rs[i]+1, rs[i+1]) for y in range(cs[j]+1, cs[j+1])]
            n = sum(1 for x in b if x == mk)
            row.append(1 if n % 2 == 0 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
